N3_V2_ensemble_max_kWh_info.note: WS1's ensemble loop used the single-pass i-MMD split (run_ws1.py line 428); WS3 applies the ratified two-pass generator reserve to every seed. Method difference, delta ~1%, not a defect.

r8_compliance.note: minimum cell temperature at which the R8 peak is available over the stated SOC range, computed against the 1.50 V/cell (432.0 V pack) floor = the exported operating_min_V (WS3-r1-F1); dispatch gate follows from these. Higher electronics floors inherit the derated gates in bus_voltage_window.dis_gate_vs_electronics_floor_V

bus_window_consistency.basis: all capability figures and every r8_compliance gate are computed against the cell floor 1.50 V/cell = 432.0 V pack; the exported operating_min_V equals this same floor, so the window and the gates are jointly satisfiable as exported (resolves WS3-r1-F1)
bus_window_consistency.soc15_note: 120 kW warm at SOC 15 sits at 527.7 V; the R8 discharge gate is declared over SOC 40-90 and full power below SOC 40 is NOT guaranteed - WS5 dispatch limit
bus_window_consistency.chg_transient_note: the 110 kW charge pulse at its +0.0 C gate rides the bus to 776.4 V - above the 748.8 V continuous charge ceiling, inside the 777.6 V transient/protect ceiling: WS2 rates the electronics for the transient ceiling

series_252_bound.note: every voltage member scales x252/288 = 0.875; per-cell power rises x288/252 so the availability gates MOVE WARMER (-1.5 C discharge / +4.5 C charge, vs -5.5 / +0.0 at 288s) and warm full-power current rises to 245 A. Do not linearly interpolate the 288s figures.

LTO-23.thermal_runaway: class 1 (no plating, oxide anode, onset >260 C)

LFP-P-20.thermal_runaway: class 2 (no O2-releasing cathode; graphite plates when cold-charged)

hybrid_SC_note.verdict: bank covering only the 5-min swing already outweighs the entire LTO-23 cell stack; battery still needed for the floors and the 50 kW continuous descent charge - rejected

resistor_bound.note: R2 blend order with the resistor RATING enforced as a hard cap; overflow lands in the friction column and is reported, not assumed zero. Friction stays 0.00 kWh on every row - GVW and +20% payload, +45 C and -10 C (WS3-r1-F6).

preconditioning.genset_fuel_note: heater fed from genset at the bus; 1.11 kWh electrical per -10 C cold start to +10 C (1.39 kWh to +15 C)

efficiency_map.note: one-way efficiency at SOC 55%; WS1's 0.97 scalar is valid below ~40-50 kW warm and optimistic at the R8 peaks and cold

cold_case_recompute.correction_note: V1_N2_cold_LTO_aux4_kW keeps WS1's 0.97/0.97 warm scalars (like-for-like with WS1's environment table); the _corrected_ figure replaces that bookkeeping loss with the WS3 -10 C resistance-model loss on the same trace (WS3-r1-F3). Headline: +20-25%.
cold_case_recompute.note: cold-soaked (unpreconditioned) LTO at -10 C accepts the full 75 kW wheel regen cap on its CONTINUOUS rating; the R7 cold case collapses to an accessory-load penalty

c_rate_check.conclusion: power-sizing at the 650 V window lands the spine at ~8C peak / ~3C continuous - inside power-cell ratings; E8's fear was correct for the floors, moot for the built pack

frontier._note: minimum pack energy forced by each requirement at 25 C; the governing term for every LTO cell size is the 288s voltage window, i.e. the pack exceeds the R8 buffer floors by construction, not by an energy need

plus45C_2000m.creepage_note: 750 V class at 2,000 m: clearance/creepage per IEC 60664 pollution degree 2 handed to WS6

minus10C_2000m.note: cold + altitude concurrent: battery limits are the -10 C column; altitude affects only the radiator, unused cold

bus_400V_class.note: 174s1p LTO-23: FAILS the 120 kW warm pulse (C-limit), accepts only ~40 kW cold vs the 64.9 kW cap; fixing either means 2P and double the energy/mass - the 650 V window is the right one

bus_voltage_window.rationale: 1P string at 650 V class keeps the R8 peaks at ~210 A / 571.8 V warm and 274 A / 437.5 V at the -5.5 C cold gate - size conductors and devices to the cold-gate current, not the warm figure. A 400 V class 174s1p string FAILS the 120 kW pulse warm (110 kW) and accepts only 40 kW cold - going 2P to fix it doubles pack energy (see sensitivity/bus_400V_class)
